# Governance

## Maintainers
HouseKeepr is maintained by the repository owner and any designated collaborators.

## Decision making
- Day-to-day decisions are made by maintainers.
- Significant changes (architecture, major UI changes, dependency shifts) should be discussed in an issue or discussion before implementation.

## Contributions and reviews
- Maintainers may request changes before merging.
- Maintainers may close or defer issues/PRs to keep scope manageable.

## Releases
Release cadence is best-effort. Changes may be merged to `main` as they’re ready.
